title: Settings
worker_email_notifications_desc: Send email notifications to workers when a new booking is created for their assigned service. Does not affect customer-facing emails.
worker_push_notifications_desc: Send PWA push notifications to workers when a new booking is created for their assigned service. Workers must enable push on their device.
admin_notifications_desc: Choose which events create in-app notifications and push notifications for admin users. Admins only — workers and customers are not affected.
admin_notifications_bookings_desc: New bookings, cancellations and reschedules across all reservation modules.
admin_notifications_form_submissions_des: New submissions from public contact and embedded forms.
admin_notifications_payments_desc: Successful, failed and refunded gateway payments.
admin_notifications_system_errors_desc: Critical sync and system failures (e.g. payment ledger unreachable). Throttled to avoid spam.
admin_notifications_none_warning: No types selected — admins will not receive in-app or push notifications. Workers are unaffected.
